rows.label: PROPOSAL · question 26 (my pick: yes)
rows.text: And that's not me saying that. Despite actually trying to train people in their model, the Zapatistas themselves have been clear that people shouldn't expect to directly or easily import/export their philosophy (Zapatismo) as something ready-made, shake & bake. The useful thing is how they learn: they build things and ask questions, and when they find out where the practice isn't working, they change the structure.
